data.body_html:
Celebrate Pride 2031 in style on a private Marbella yacht charter. Depart from Puerto Banús with your closest friends, a chilled bottle of cava, and the Mediterranean glistening ahead. Whether you want a two-hour sunset cruise or a full-day voyage to Estepona, our fleet of luxury motor yachts and sailboats offers something for every group size and budget. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% VAT — no surprises. Pride 2031 falls on Saturday 29 June 2031, so secure your dates early.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Pride 2031?

Pride in Marbella is a vibrant, inclusive celebration. A private yacht adds an exclusive dimension — you control the music, the route, and the guest list. Anchor at a quiet cove like Cala Cortés or Cala del Faro for a swim, or stay close to the action and watch the fireworks from the water. With a maximum of 12 guests per boat, you get an intimate, safe space to celebrate. No crowded clubs, no queues — just the sea and your crew.

Our Fleet for Pride 2031

All yachts depart from Puerto Banús. Below are the most popular options for a Pride celebration. Prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

For smaller groups, the Marbella yacht charter fleet also includes the Dubhe (5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (5 pax) — perfect for an intimate Pride 2031 outing.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every booking comes with a professional, licensed skipper who knows the Costa del Sol coastline intimately. Fuel is covered. Onboard, you’ll find a cooler stocked with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. Insurance and safety equipment are included. Spanish IVA at 21% is already in the price. No hidden fees, no tipping required.

Suggested Itineraries for Pride 2031

Your skipper will adapt the route to your preferences. Popular options include:

  • Sunset Cruise (2h): Puerto Banús → Golden Mile → Marbella Marina → back. €749.
  • Half-Day Escape (4h): Puerto Banús → Cala del Faro → swim stop → Cabopino → return. From €1,499.
  • Full-Day Voyage (8h): Puerto Banús → Estepona → lunch anchorage → Sotogrande → return. From €2,299.

The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski — perfect for exploring coves or towing friends.

How to Book Your Pride 2031 Yacht

Demand for Pride 2031 will be high. Contact us via WhatsApp or the booking form on our website to check availability. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance, especially for larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80. A deposit secures your date; balance is due 14 days before departure.
